title: Fintech Applications: Gearing for Social Problem Solving in India
content: Abstract: Fintech (financial era) is emerging as a powerful catalyst for addressing social challenges in India. by way of mixing era with economic services, fintech is riding financial inclusion, empowering micro and small establishments (MSMEs), transforming agriculture, improving healthcare accessibility, and promoting gender equality. virtual price systems and cell banking offerings are enabling the unbanked to participate within the formal economic system, whilst fintech-driven lending platforms are presenting capital to underserved MSMEs. In agriculture, fintech is offering tailored financial merchandise and market get admission to to farmers, improving rural livelihoods. moreover, fintech is intersecting with health tech to make healthcare cheap and available, and micro-insurance products are protective low-income populations. Fintech platforms also are empowering girls with economic tools and fostering social impact through crowdfunding and effect making an investment. As fintech maintains to evolve, its potential to resolve India’s social problems and promote inclusive growth remains enormous.
